agent_comments:
This behaviour is intended, and the reporter has already found the cause. When output is not a terminal (for example, piped through `tee`), Rich writes plain text without control codes, so a progress bar cannot update in place. See the [Console docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst) for `is_terminal` and `force_terminal`. If you need in-place updates while the output is piped, set `force_terminal=True` on the `Console`. For further questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
